Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute
right knee pain and swelling. Over the course of 18 visits, care consisted of
conservative management including physical therapy, activity modification, and
anti-inflammatory medication. Examinatoin findings included localized tenderness and a
positive effusion on initial assessment, which support a knee injury, while several
ligamentous and neurovascular tests remained within normal limits. No prior injury to
the same region is documented in the available history. Treatment followed an expected
progression, with visit freuqency decreasing as range of motion and pain improved.
Whether the current knee findings are causally related to this collision cannot yet be
determined and will be reassessed at follow-up. Billed services reflect the treatment
rendered, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
